info.title: Peable API
info.description: The Peable payments API (Orbit): FairCoin and card payments, Checkout, Payment Links, Billing, Connect and Tax. Amounts are base-unit integer strings; instants are Unix seconds; every object carries `id`, `object` and `livemode`. Guides: https://oxy.so/developers/docs/peable/.

connected_account.description: The seller (`ca_…`) this line is sold by (ADR 0021 D6). customer_creation.description: Default `if_required` (a customer is created only when something needs one).

payment_method_types.description: Must include `faircoin`, which is always offered (ADR 0021; leaving it out is 400 `payment_method_locked`). On a fiat order `['card', 'faircoin']` (the default) or `['faircoin']` — a FairCoin-only order, the fiat methods being the merchant's to turn off; on a FAIR order `['faircoin']`.
